residual.wall: Displacement is three writers and two spaces, not one map. Studios author one field on a locked cage. We shade a height, puff a rim, and leave the lattice offsets aside.

question: What is a lawful displacement-mapping workflow on the 512/360/1000 lock, and what must not be imported from bitmap VDM pipelines?
coordinateSpaces: Map UV = polar 25×40, u=sector/40 wrapped, v=ring/24 clamped. Scalar live space = rest-radial (contract) or contour-radius at ring 24 (paint). Shade space = screen-space height in shadeLitMesh (H × height). Vector contract space = object-ish unit sphere along restNormalAt. Tangent space = AdaptiveShell local frames (computed, unused). meshOffsets = 360 × (Δx, Δy) content-px, not a map. Midpoint = +0, never 0.5 gray.
physicalLaw: Topology is the cage. Displacement is a primvar on that cage. It does not remesh (OpenSubdiv / USD).
Scalar displace: P' = P + n̂ · s · A. Vector: P' = P + R · v · A, R = object or tangent frame.
Amplitude 0 is identity. Midpoint is +0, not 128/255. PxrDispTransform remaps; we do not ship 8-bit maps.
One field, two consumers: shade (normals from the field) and silhouette (rim coupling). Not four independent writers.
1000 is the tessellation. SVG cannot dicing-tessellate. Do not invent a 4k bitmap to look like RenderMan.
artisticLaw: Goose is a regional scalar map. Blowfish is a radial scalar map. Remote is a new cage embedding or a captured vector, not a height bitmap of a remote.
Do not paint a face with displacement (Book 009). Pupils stay seq18.
Sculpt drag (meshOffsets) is captured vector on the 360, resampled to 1000 if it must join the map. It is not a second workflow.
invariants: Neutral field is +0 on every sample.
failureModes: shadeLitMesh looks displaced while the 512 is still a pearl — shade-only, no silhouette (current goose at rim-zero).
Pressure puffs the rim while shade stays flat — silhouette-only (current N350 puff).
meshOffsets sculpt a dent the 1000 never sees.
Import a 16-bit EXR as if we had Ptex. We have 1000 floats. Resample or refuse.
0.5-as-rest (8-bit displacement convention) would bias the pearl forever.
Tangent VDM without using computeLocalFrame — RGB as XYZ in the wrong space shears him.
uncertainty: Whether captured should be Float32[1000] scalar or [1000×3] vector first. Scalar matches live z-buffer. Vector matches C.
Whether sculpt meshOffsets promote to captured each frame or stay a lattice-only edit until baked.
tests: Zero map: shade empty, rim 0, 512 unchanged.
Same scalar field: shade quads AND rim move; counts stay 512/1000.
No painter path samples an image texture for hull displace.
visualConsequences: Today: puff changes outline, goose changes grain, sculpt changes a hidden 360. They do not read as one skin.
Mastered: one Skin map. Puff and goose are layers on it. Outline and grain agree.
implementation: Do not add a bitmap pipeline.
The 1000-float field IS the displacement map. Author it (presets, paint-on-UV later, import resampled to 25×40).
Bind: one UV law (u=sector, v=ring). Document it on the Skin chapter.
Apply: captured + pressure + relief → composeScaffoldScalars → commitScaffoldField. ShadeLitMesh reads the SAME scalars (not a second evaluateRelief-only path).
Space v1: scalar along rest-radial (already). Space v2 later: tangent via computeLocalFrame. Do not ship object-VDM until L is the live 360, not the rest sphere.
meshOffsets: bake to captured on Save, or resample 360→1000. Do not leave as a silent fifth writer.
Skin UI: show the 25×40 as the map (readout + layers Pressure / Relief / Captured). Neutral clears all three to +0.
No gait recut. No firewall drop. No 4k EXR.
